{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "point force at the midpoint of the right edge",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies the force location but gives no direction or components. The downward direction in Sec. 4.2 belongs to a different example.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward.",
        "Horizontally rightward.",
        "At 45 degrees downward and rightward."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "point force at the midpoint of the right edge",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 makes loads dimensionless, but Sec. 4.1 and the Fig. 7 caption give no force magnitude.",
      "readings": [
        "Force magnitude 1.",
        "Force magnitude 0.1.",
        "Force magnitude 10."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "2D elastic constitutive model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 supplies Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio but does not specify the 2D constitutive assumption.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies the in-plane rectangle but gives no thickness or explicit unit-depth convention for the element stiffness and applied force.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1, with the point force interpreted as a total resultant.",
        "Uniform thickness t=2, with the same total force."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "solid attachment regions at the clamp and load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 does not state whether any attachment elements in the rectangular model are held solid rather than optimized.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive solid elements.",
        "Hold the leftmost element column solid.",
        "Hold the leftmost column and the two right-edge elements adjacent to the load node solid."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "finite-element interpolation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The square grid and Table 3 establish the element count, but the text never specifies the element interpolation or quadrature defining the reference element stiffness.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2-by-2 Gauss integration.",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3-by-3 Gauss integration.",
        "Nine-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3-by-3 Gauss integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density lower bound and numerical treatment of void",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Eq. (4) requires strictly positive densities and gives pure SIMP stiffness, whereas Sec. 2.3 requires a fully 0–1 distribution. No numerical floor or treatment of exact voids is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a density floor of 0.001 in analysis and classify floor-density elements as void.",
        "Use a density floor of 0.000001 in analysis and classify floor-density elements as void.",
        "Permit exact zero densities after binarization and eliminate void-only degrees of freedom from the analysis."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density filter for thickness control",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.2 identifies a density filter and Fig. 11 labels r_min, but no averaging kernel or distance metric is provided for Fig. 7's stated value of 1.5.",
      "readings": [
        "Euclidean-distance weights max(0, 1.5-d), normalized over neighboring elements.",
        "Uniform averaging over element centers within Euclidean radius 1.5.",
        "Gaussian weights with standard deviation 0.75, truncated at radius 1.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No boundary rule is given for the thickness filter. Sec. 3.2's explicit void padding applies to unsupported-element detection, not necessarily to density averaging.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the averaging neighborhood and renormalize using only elements inside the rectangle.",
        "Pad outside with zero density and retain the full-kernel normalization.",
        "Reflect densities across the rectangular boundary."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density fields used by stiffness, volume, and self-support constraints",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 2.2, 2.3, and 3.1 introduce filtering and projection without distinguishing optimization variables from filtered or projected physical densities in the constraint evaluations.",
      "readings": [
        "Use projected physical densities for stiffness, volume, and the self-support constraint.",
        "Use projected physical densities for stiffness and self-support, but unfiltered design variables for volume."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Heaviside projection definition",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 2.3 and 3.1 name a Guest Heaviside filter but provide no projection equation or threshold parameter in the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Exponential projection P(q)=1-exp(-beta*q)+q*exp(-beta).",
        "Normalized tanh projection with threshold eta=0.5.",
        "Normalized tanh projection with threshold eta=0.3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "projection activation and sharpness continuation",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 says projection occurs in the last few steps; Sec. 4.1.1 shows a black-white state at step 45 and a final state at 166. No sharpness values or continuation schedule are specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Activate projection at iteration 45 with beta=64 and keep it fixed.",
        "Start beta=1 at iteration 21, double it every four iterations to beta=64 at iteration 45, then hold it fixed."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "conversion to exact binary densities",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 promises a totally 0–1 distribution, but does not specify a hard cutoff or how the resulting binary structure is used in the final compliance and volume evaluations.",
      "readings": [
        "Round projected densities at 0.5 and recompute stiffness and volume on the binary structure.",
        "Round projected densities at 0.9 and recompute stiffness and volume on the binary structure."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial density distribution",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 describes obtaining a coarse structure but does not specify the density field from which that first optimization starts.",
      "readings": [
        "Start every design element at density 0.6.",
        "Start every design element at density 1.",
        "Start every design element at density 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA numerical controls and stage transition",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 names MMA but gives no move limits, asymptote controls, subproblem tolerances, or rule for retaining optimizer history when self-support constraints are introduced.",
      "readings": [
        "Move limit 0.1; initial asymptote half-width 0.5; expansion 1.2; contraction 0.7; subproblem tolerance 1e-6; reset history at the stage transition.",
        "Move limit 0.2; initial asymptote half-width 0.5; expansion 1.2; contraction 0.7; subproblem tolerance 1e-6; retain history.",
        "Move limit 0.2; initial asymptote half-width 0.2; expansion 1.1; contraction 0.5; subproblem tolerance 1e-8; reset history."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "final optimization stopping criteria",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Beyond the stated coarse-stage non-discreteness test, the text gives no final convergence tolerances for the reference or self-supporting optimization. Fig. 9's final iteration number does not define a stopping rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when applicable constraints are satisfied and maximum density change is below 0.001.",
        "Stop when applicable constraints are satisfied and relative compliance change stays below 0.0001 for ten iterations.",
        "Stop when constraint feasibility and a KKT residual below 0.000001 are achieved."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "self-supporting run: support-detection threshold",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 explicitly says practical gray-density detection needs a value replacing zero in the sign test, but never gives that value.",
      "readings": [
        "Use the literal convolution-sum test greater than zero.",
        "Require the supporting-density sum to exceed 0.001.",
        "Require the supporting-density sum to exceed 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "self-supporting run: candidate elements tested for support",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 describes support for a solid element, but Eqs. (1)–(3) define the unsupported set over the whole mesh. No target-element density cutoff distinguishes solid candidates from void or gray cells.",
      "readings": [
        "Test every mesh cell and rely on its squared density to weight its contribution to U.",
        "Test only cells with density greater than 0.5.",
        "Test only cells with density strictly above the numerical density floor."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "self-supporting run: final tolerance epsilon_0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.2 and 2.3 require a small final tolerance on the sum of squared unsupported densities but provide no numerical epsilon_0.",
      "readings": [
        "Absolute epsilon_0=0.000001.",
        "Absolute epsilon_0=0.001.",
        "Absolute epsilon_0=0.01."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "self-supporting run: relaxation schedule for epsilon",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 only says epsilon decreases continuously from a relatively large value to epsilon_0; neither its initial value nor its reduction rule is given.",
      "readings": [
        "Start at twice the coarse structure's U and multiply epsilon by 0.95 each iteration until epsilon_0.",
        "Start at twice the coarse structure's U and decrease linearly to epsilon_0 over 100 iterations.",
        "Start at epsilon=9000 and halve it every ten iterations until epsilon_0."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "self-supporting run: final unsupported-element removal",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 calls for removal when the unsupported count stops decreasing, but gives no plateau duration, cascade-removal rule, or specification of subsequent reoptimization.",
      "readings": [
        "After one unchanged count, recursively delete unsupported solid elements until none remain, without reoptimization.",
        "After ten iterations without improvement, fix unsupported elements to zero, rerun MMA, and repeat until none remain.",
        "At optimization convergence, delete one unsupported element at a time and reoptimize after each deletion."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
